# We report the ORF as fwd span [N-(k+2), N-j]
def span_from_rev(j0, jend):
    # j0 : rev index of first base (A of ATG)
    # jend : rev index of last base of stop codon
    fstart = N - j0            # forward coord of 5' base (A of ATG)

                while k+3<=N and rcs[k:k+3] not in ('TAA','TAG','TGA'): k+=3
                if k+3<=N and rcs[k:k+3] in ('TAA','TAG','TGA'):
                    prot=transl(rcs[j:k+3])
                    L=len(prot)-1

                        fstart=N-j; fend=N-(k+2)
                        out.append((L,fstart,fend,frame+1,prot[:-1]))
                j+=3
            else: j+=3
    return out
